pages.en: Lily has ten pounds from Grandpa. She goes shopping with Mum in the town centre. "What can I buy?" she thinks.
pages.zh: 爷爷给了 Lily 十英镑。她和妈妈去市中心购物。“我能买什么呢？”她想。
pages.scene: A busy shopping street, Lily walking with Mum and holding a small purse, shop windows full of toys, books and clothes.

pages.en: In the toy shop, there is a big doll, but it is very expensive. In the bookshop, Lily finds a book about horses. It costs six pounds.
pages.zh: 在玩具店里，有一个大娃娃，可是太贵了。在书店里，Lily 找到一本关于马的书，价格是六英镑。
pages.scene: Inside a cosy bookshop, Lily holding a book with a horse on the cover and smiling, Mum next to her, full shelves behind them.

pages.en: Lily pays for the book, and the shop assistant gives her the change. Now she has four pounds. "I can buy a present for Tom too!" she says.
pages.zh: Lily 付钱买了书，店员找给她零钱。现在她还剩四英镑。“我还能给 Tom 买个礼物！”她说。
pages.scene: Lily paying at a bookshop counter, a friendly shop assistant giving her coins as change, Lily smiling with the book under her arm.

questions.q: Lily has four pounds at the end.
questions.zh: 最后 Lily 还剩四英镑。
